protocol.name: cupertino_overview_v1

description.summary: the windows and workspaces of an output, for the component that shows the overview

protocol.description:
The overview is a component's: it draws a surface over the output, shows each window in a hole of that surface (cupertino_hole_v1), claims the windows while it is open and moves them with transactions (cupertino_transaction_v1), bound to the gestures that open and close it. The server keeps no overview of its own. Through this protocol it tells the component which windows and workspaces the output has and when the person asks for the overview, and takes what the component picked.
The protocol is private: the server and the hosts are built from one source. Every change of a message raises the version of its interface, and a message added after version 1 carries the version that added it. A host binds an interface only at the version it was built with (cupertino_host_v1).

interface.name: cupertino_overview_manager_v1
interface.description: Global singleton, offered only to a connection that holds the overview role.

entry.name: role
entry.summary: the output is gone or already has an overview object

entry.name: permission
entry.summary: the connection does not hold the overview role

request.name: destroy
request.description: Overview objects created through this global stay valid.

request.name: get_overview

description.summary: follow the windows and workspaces of an output

request.description: Makes the client the overview of the output. It needs no surface. Posts the role error when the output is gone or already has an overview object, and permission when the connection does not hold the overview role, which is checked on every request.

interface.name: cupertino_overview_v1
interface.description:
Events come in groups ended by a done event; the client applies a group at once. The first group, sent right after the object is created, has the area, every window and every workspace. Coordinates are global logical coordinates, the space the outputs are arranged in and the one cupertino_window_manager_v1 uses: the component subtracts the output's origin to place a frame on a surface of the output. Window ids are the server's, the same as the dock's and the window manager's; workspace ids are stable for a workspace's lifetime.
The windows are the top-level windows without a parent on the output's current workspace or on every workspace, minimized ones included, of applications that are not hidden.

description.summary: give up the overview of the output

event.name: area

description.summary: the area the windows are laid out in

event.description: The output from its top edge down to the bottom of its usable area, across the usable width: clear of the dock, and over the menu bar. Sent in the first group and on every change.

entry.name: active
entry.summary: the key window of the session

event.name: window
event.description: Application id (the desktop entry id when known), title, frame and state of a window. The frame is where the window shows without a claim of this connection, with its server-side decorations and without its shadow: its own frame on the desktop, or, for a window another connection claims (a window of the stage strip), the bounds at rest of the hole that claims it. A hole of the overview that opens or closes there takes the window over, or gives it back, without a jump (cupertino_hole_v1.set_claim). For a minimized window it is the frame it had before it was minimized. Sent when the window joins the set and again whenever one of these changes. The application id and the title are each cut to at most 1024 bytes at a UTF-8 character boundary.

event.name: window_closed
event.description: It closed, went to another output or workspace, or its application was hidden.

entry.name: full_screen
entry.summary: the workspace of a full-screen window: it is not removed or reordered and takes no other window

event.name: workspace
event.description: One workspace of the output, in order, with its state. A group that has workspace events lists every workspace: they replace the earlier list. The full_screen bit names the workspaces that remove_workspace, move_workspace and move_window leave alone, so the component offers none of them for those.

entry.name: all
entry.summary: every window of the current workspace, with the workspaces

event.name: toggle

description.summary: the person asked for the overview

event.description: The overview shortcut, a hot corner or a named action asks for the overview of this output in mode: the component opens it, or closes it when it is open. app_id is the application of the app mode, the active one, and empty in the all mode. Not sent while the session is locked or a lock is pending. A gesture reaches the component through the transaction it bound to it, not through this event.

description.summary: end of a group of events

request.name: activate_window
request.description: Show the window: restore it when it is minimized, raise and focus it. A window change: inside the bracket of a transaction it is carried out at the transaction's start. An id that is not a window of the set when the request is carried out is ignored, and so is every request while the session is locked.

request.name: switch_workspace

description.summary: go to a workspace of the output

request.description: Switches the output to the workspace. A window change. An unknown id is ignored: the workspace may have just been removed.

description.summary: append a workspace to the output

request.name: remove_workspace

description.summary: remove a workspace of the output

request.description: Its windows move to the workspace before it, else the one after. The last regular workspace, a full-screen one and an unknown id are ignored.

request.name: move_workspace

description.summary: reorder a workspace of the output

request.description: Moves the workspace to position index (0-based) among the output's workspaces; an index past the end moves it last. A full-screen workspace and an unknown id are ignored.

request.name: move_window

description.summary: move a window to a workspace of the output

request.description: The window leaves the set, which is sent again. A window change. An id that is not in the set, an unknown workspace, a full-screen workspace and the current one are ignored.
